name: Sakurabashi Yuria
source:
Yuria works as an idol with her older twin sister Miria. Years of training by Miria has made her into a proper sweet and demure girl who dreams of being a bride someday. She represents the ideal girl Shinsuke is looking for making her the ideal candidate for joining the bunny club. If only Shinsuke can get her sister's approval first.

[spoiler]Is sexually teased and feminized by his older sister who forces him to hide the fact that he's a boy. Going so far as to force him to properly call his penis a "clitoris" and rewarding him with sex when he obeys.[/spoiler]
